# `unbraced-multiline-if`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports an unbraced `if` whose single body statement begins on a later line.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Subsequent indented statements can look guarded even though Zig associates only
the first statement with the condition.

## When it fires

Enable it where multiline control flow should always use braces to make scope
visually unambiguous.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn run(x: bool) void {
    if (x)
        doIt();
}

fn doIt() void {}
```
